summary: A short note closing out the gravel path work: what was laid, how much it took, and what is left over.

# The gravel path resurfacing is done

The path from the gate to the shared beds has a fresh layer of gravel now,
about two inches deep over the old base, and the low spot that used to
hold water after storms is filled and level. It took four wheelbarrow
loads more than expected, and the leftover gravel is stacked by the
toolshed for whoever tackles the side path next.
